title: Bootstrapping Fermionic Veneziano Amplitudes from Regge Zeros
summary: We extend the Regge-zero bootstrap of the Veneziano amplitude to tree-level scattering with external fermions. We consider the colour-ordered four-point amplitude of a massless scalar and a massless spin-$\frac12$ fermion, in which fermionic resonances appear in the $s$-channel and bosonic resonances in the $t$-channel. Factoring out a spinor structure that carries the little-group weight of the amplitude, we bootstrap the resulting reduced amplitude, whose residues in each channel vanish at Regge zeros controlled by the trajectory of the opposite channel.
